messages:
jordana: heads-up: saw quota/traffic counters show other orgs' data after quick org switch in console this AM

ryan: can you repro and paste what you saw?

jordana: yes. repro steps: 1) open console logged-in as org-alpha, 2) open Traffic -> Service X, 3) switch to org-beta in header dropdown fast, 4) hit refresh. Page briefly shows alpha lanes and quota usage and then corrects.

teo: do we have a sample network trace or headers?

jordana: grabbed one from devtools: 
GET /internal/rollouts/traffic?service=X 200 OK
request headers: {"authorization": "Bearer ...", "x-org-id": "org-beta", "x-route":"rollout-4"}
response body: {"service":"X","lanes":[{"org":"org-alpha","pct":8}, ...],"_cache_meta":"key=rollout:traffic:rollout-4"}

margo: that _cache_meta is suspicious. backend probably returning cached blob keyed by route only.

teo: if cache key lacks org, concurrent requests with different x-org-id will race and one response may fill cache for others. Not unheard of.

infra-bot: alert: found similar pattern on quota-service last month: cache key = quota:v1:service-X (no org).

ryan: two questions: 1) is this frontend showing stale data or did the backend incorrectly attribute telemetry/usage to the wrong org? 2) scope of impact?

jordana: both: UI showed stale lanes, and we emitted telemetry events with org=org-alpha for actions performed while in org-beta (so billing/metrics taint). I have a short list of affected pages: Rollouts Traffic, Quotas dashboard, Insights > Prefetch summary.

margo: immediate mitigations: 1) block-serving cached responses that do not match request header org; 2) evict affected cache keys; 3) patch cache keying.

teo: for #1 we can modify gateway proxy to check cached.response.org_id vs incoming header and treat as miss if mismatch. Cheap and quick.

ryan: prefer backend fix (cache key contains org) but gateway check as defensive short-term.

ops: can run eviction. Suggested command to find keys:
```
redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern 'rollout:traffic:*' | sed -n '1,200p'
redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern 'quota:v1:*' | xargs -r redis-cli -n 0 del
```

infra-bot: creating INC-2027 for cross-org cache leakage, severity: medium until telemetry backfill confirms extent.

teo: proposed fix: 1) change cache key composition to include org-id and cache-version (eg: rollout:traffic:v2:{org}:{route}), 2) add Vary: X-Org-ID on internal responses and include x-org-id in cache label, 3) add feature flag to flip for canary.

margo: also add a short-lived guard in console: ignore payloads where payload.org !== currentOrg, log warn, and show a subtle banner 'Data may be stale after org switch; refresh recommended'.

jordana: added a tiny try-it:
```
if (payload.org !== currentOrg) { console.warn('org mismatch', payload.org, currentOrg); return; }
```

ryan: telemetry: we'll need to scan events for same time window and tag misattributed events. teo, can you add a job to backfill tag=cache-org-mismatch for events between 04:00-05:30 UTC?

teo: yes. I'll run a map-reduce over the event index matching service=rollout-service and heuristics: event.payload.org != event.request_header.x_org_id. Will produce CSV for billing team.

ops: timeline for eviction & short-term guard?

margo: ops please evict rollout/traffic and quota keys now. Then we deploy gateway guard and console guard in staging today.

ops: running eviction: 
```
redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern 'rollout:traffic:*' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli -n 0 del
redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern 'quota:v1:*' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli -n 0 del
```

infra-bot: ops completed key deletion at 2025-11-08T11:12:00Z, 412 keys removed.

teo: I'll open PR to change keying and Vary header. Plan: change to rollout:traffic:v2:{org}:{route}, add feature flag rollout.cache_org_key=true. Add unit tests for key composition and integration test hitting service with alternating X-Org-ID headers to assert no cross-serve.

ryan: canary plan: staging -> prod canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Monitor metrics: per-org cache-hit-ratio and org-header-mismatch-rate. Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.05% in 5m.

margo: also run a quick grep across services for route-only keys: grep -R "rollout:traffic" --exclude-dir=vendor | xargs -n1 sed -n '1,120p' ; do this for 'quota:v1' and 'prefetch:*' as well. Post results in INC-2027.

jordana: who owns the console banner/guard?

margo: assigning console guard to jordana, gateway guard + cache-key flip to teo, ops remains for eviction/backfill, ryan will coordinate telemetry backfill.

ops: noted. Tagged owners on INC-2027.

teo: one more thought: for long-term, consider signing cache keys with a short HMAC of org+route+version so accidental collisions are impossible, and version bumps can be fast-rollbacks if needed.

ryan: good idea. Also add automated chaos test: repeatedly switch orgs and assert UI never shows lanes from previous org for more than 200ms. Add to e2e harness.

jordana: thanks all. temporary admin workaround: hard refresh after switching orgs or use incognito tabs. Will update INC-2027 with canary progress. :white_check_mark:
